title: Studio verdict (batches/<id>/verdict.json)
description: Written by the page when the user presses Submit. Never written for them.

note.description: The user's note on the whole batch, exact.

answer.description: For a question: the user's answer in their own words.

marks.description: Parts of the picture or model the user painted, in up to five colours, each with a note. The page also keeps a picture of them at marks/<candidate>.png.

notes.description: colour -> the user's note for that colour, exact

where.description: colour -> where those marks sit, worked out by the page

strokes.description: On a picture: {c: colour or erase, r: radius in the picture's pixels, p: [[x, y], ...]}

size.description: On a picture: its width and height in pixels

faces.description: On a model: mesh number -> colour -> face numbers

meshes.description: On a model: mesh number -> its name

moments.description: On a moving model: colour -> {clip, t, length}, the motion and the second it was painted at
